How this works

1Type the salt. Composition first, not brand names — a brand cannot be resolved to a composition without a dataset that does not exist publicly.

2Two official numbers. The NPPA ceiling is the legally binding maximum. The Jan Aushadhi price is the government's own generic. Both are matched on strength and dosage form.

3The record. CDSCO's list of batches that failed testing, and WHO's alerts. Kept in separate tiers, never blended.

Nuskha does not give medical advice and never instructs a substitution. Composition match is not proven therapeutic equivalence. Always ask your prescriber.
